title: Run final pre-Alpha clean-room rehearsal
scope: Freeze an exact post-WI-0157 Temple package and neutral QueueKeep participant brief without publication.
Run one fresh Terra medium delivery task and one separate Terra medium cold-recovery task with no inherited Temple conversation or maintainer coaching.

Record elapsed time, errors, retries, rework, Human interventions, application tests, Status, Doctor, and reliable or unknown Token data; compare only with the bounded WI-0155 and WI-0156 observations.
Reconcile the validation index and Alpha release-readiness record while keeping version, visibility, tag, GitHub Release, npm, and announcement decisions separate.
acceptance_criteria: A clean exact-source package digest and inventory are frozen before any Provider task starts.
The delivery task either closes one bounded local Work Item with distinct Developer and Independent QA identities or retains its exact stop condition without coaching.
A second neutral cold task recovers the target repository state and next safe action from repository-visible evidence only, without coordinator Work Item contamination.
The final report states measured outcomes and limits, preserves unavailable Token data as unknown, and does not claim general speed, quality, or cost improvement from one run.
Exact-candidate repository verification, distinct Independent QA, and hosted CI pass before integration; no public release action occurs.

profile_assessment.rationale: Provider-backed release qualification needs explicit evidence, independent review, and a retained stop boundary.
